about: A made-up plan, for the examples of the operation pages and for the pictures: relaunching the web site of a shop, with a mobile app that waits for it. It has groups, dependencies inside and between them, a bug, an incident, and tasks in most statuses. The build replays these calls, in this order, through the HTTP API of a service it started. "as" is the user who calls, "gives" the ID the service has to answer with, and "at" the made-up moment the call is shown to have been made at, in the place of the real one.

input.title: Website relaunch
input.description: Move the shop to the new platform.

input.title: Mobile app
input.description: A first app for returning customers.

input.title: Checkout: a customer can pay for a basket
input.description: Cart, payment and confirmation. Done when a test order goes through from basket to email.
input.why: Orders are taken by email today, and half of them are abandoned before they are paid.

input.title: Cart page lists the items and the total
input.description: Done when items can be added and removed and the total is right.

input.title: Payment form takes a card
input.description: Collect the card details and charge the total. Done when a test card is charged and a declined card says why.
input.why: Without it nothing can be sold. It is also where most customers gave up on the old site.

input.title: Confirmation email is sent after payment
input.description: Done when the email arrives with the order number.

input.title: Total is wrong when a coupon is applied twice
input.description: Applying the same coupon twice takes the discount off twice. Done when the second attempt is refused.
input.why: It would give away money on every order from launch day.

input.title: Search: products are found by name and category
input.description: Done when the ten most searched words give the right products.

input.title: Index all products every night
input.description: Done when a new product is found the next morning.

input.title: Search box with suggestions in the header
input.description: Done when typing three letters shows suggestions.

input.title: Filters for price and category
input.description: Done when results can be narrowed by both.

input.title: Accounts: customers sign in with their old password
input.description: Done when every customer of the old shop can sign in.

input.title: Import customer accounts from the old shop
input.description: Done when the count matches the old database.

input.title: Password reset by email
input.description: Done when a reset link arrives and works once.

input.title: Launch: the domain points to the new site
input.description: Done when the old site is switched off and orders arrive on the new one.
input.why: Everything else is preparation for this day.

input.title: Staging site is down after the last deploy
input.description: The staging site answers 502 since this morning. Done when it is up and the cause is written down.

input.title: App icon and store listing
input.description: Done when the listing is approved.

input.title: Home screen shows the latest orders
input.description: Done when the three latest orders are listed with their state.

input.title: Push notification when an order ships
input.description: Done when a test order sends one.
